passive.name: Duelist's Dance
passive.description: Fiora has revealed a <keywordMajor>Vital</keywordMajor> on this Champion. If she hits the <keywordMajor>Vital</keywordMajor>, she <healing>restores Health</healing> and gains <speed>Move Speed</speed>.

spells.name: Lunge
spells.description: Fiora lunges in a direction and stabs a nearby enemy, dealing physical damage and applying on-hit effects.
spells.tooltip:
Fiora lunges in a direction and stabs the closest enemy, ward, or structure, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage. The strike will prioritize Vitals and enemies it will kill.

If Fiora strikes an enemy, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced by {{ cdrefundpercent*100 }}%.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Riposte
spells.description: Fiora parries all incoming damage and disables for a short time, then stabs in a direction. This stab slows the first enemy champion hit, or stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with this ability.
spells.tooltip: Fiora parries all incoming damage, disables, and negative effects for {{ parryduration }} seconds, then stabs. The stab deals <magicDamage>{{ stabdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to the first champion hit and <status>Slows</status> <speed>Move Speed</speed> by {{ msslowpercent*-100 }}%<attackSpeed> and Attack Speed by {{ attackslowpercent*-100 }}% </attackSpeed> for {{ ccduration }} seconds. If Fiora parries an <status>Immobilizing</status> effect, the stabbed enemy is <status>Stunned</status> rather than <status>Slowed</status>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Bladework
spells.description: Fiora has increased attack speed for the next two attacks. The first attack slows the target, and the second attack will critically strike.
spells.tooltip: Fiora gains <attackSpeed>{{ aspercent*100 }}% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> for her next two Attacks. The first Attack <status>Slows</status> by {{ slowpercent*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }} second. The second Attack always critically strikes for <physicalDamage>{{ attacktwopercenttad*100 }}% damage</physicalDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Grand Challenge
spells.description: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on an enemy champion and gains Move Speed while near them. If Fiora hits all four Vitals or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora and her allies in the area are healed over the next few seconds.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Duelist's Dance Move Speed bonus is increased to {{ percentms*100 }}%.

Active: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on a champion for a max of {{ spell.fiorapassive:rdamagetotal }} max Health true damage and gains Duelist's Dance's Move Speed bonus while near the target.

If Fiora strikes all four Vitals within {{ markduration }} seconds or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora restores {{ healpersecondcalc }} Health per second to surrounding allied champions for {{ healduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

variants.name: Duelist's Dance
effects: Innate: Fiora identifies the Vitals of nearby visible enemy champions, marked as an arc around them in North-, East-, South- or Westward direction. Vitals take 1.75 seconds to become targetable and linger for 13.25 seconds afterwards while Fiora remains near the target, otherwise the Vital will disappear. After a Vital ends, Fiora identifies a new one on her target.

Dealing damage in the direction of a Vital will trigger it to deal bonus true damage equal to 3% (+ 4% per 100 bonus AD) of target's maximum health, heal Fiora for 35 : 100 (based on level), and grant her 20% / 30% / 40% / 50% (based on Grand Challenge's Rank) bonus movement speed that decays over 1.85 seconds.

variants.name: Lunge
effects: Active: Fiora dashes in the target direction, then stabs a nearby enemy. Lunge can hit structures and wards. Stabbing a target reduces Lunge's cooldown by 50%.
Fiora can cast any of her abilities during the dash. The target does not have to be visible to be hit by this ability, unless it is a ward.

variants.name: Riposte
effects: Active: Fiora enters a defensive stance for 0.75 seconds, during which she is unable to act, prevents all incoming non- turret damage, and gains debuff immunity and crowd control immunity.
The enemy champion struck is also slowed and crippled by 25% for 2 seconds. If Riposte negates at least one hostile immobilizing effect, Fiora stuns the target for the same duration instead.

variants.name: Bladework
effects: Bladework resets Fiora's basic attack timer.

variants.name: Grand Challenge
effects: Active: Fiora challenges the target enemy champion for 8 seconds, highlighting all four of their Vitals after a 0.5-second delay. While in effect, Duelist's Dance does not identify new Vitals on Fiora's target.
While near the target, Fiora gains Duelist's Dance's bonus movement speed.
Unlike Duelist's Dance, the Vitals will continue to linger even if Fiora is not nearby.

changes.title: R - Grand Challenge
changes.text: Heal per Second : 40 / 60 / 70 / 80 / 100% based on vitals ⇒ 100% always

changes.title: R - Grand Challenge
changes.text: Obvious Healing : Healing circle effects now persist for the full 5 second duration (no gameplay change)

changes.title: W - Riposte
changes.text: Attack Speed Slow : 50% for 2 seconds ⇒ 25% for 2 seconds

changes.title: Passive - Duelist’s Dance
changes.text: Maximum Health Damage AD Scaling : 4.5% maximum health true damage per 100 AD ⇒ 4% maximum health true damage per 100 AD

changes.title: Passive - Duelist's Dance
changes.text: Bonus True Damage: 3% (+5.5% per 100 bonus AD) ⇒ 3% (+4.5% per 100 bonus AD) of target's maximum health

changes.title: Passive - Duelist’s Dance
changes.text: MARK DAMAGE: 2.5% (+4.5% per 100 AD) ⇒ 3% (+5.5% per 100 AD)

changes.title: General
changes.text: W - RIPOSTE BUGFIX REVERT: Reverting a bugfix from 10.18 that attempted to fix a bug where Fiora would trigger her enemy's Vitals through a Spell Shield. The bugfix introduced a new bug that would negatively impact Fiora's play in Worlds, so while we will fix this in the future, we'll opting to revert any changes to her this patch.

changes.title: Q - Lunge
changes.text: TOWER DEFENSE: Can now hit turrets and wards (will prioritize champion vitals, ultimate targets, champs, dying minions, turrets, and wards, respectively)
